cases.expectation: A general aphorism without an opening may receive silence.
Recognize harmless dog/startup wordplay and respond proportionately or use a quiet signal.
Understand the cat/stealth-company metaphor without literalizing it.
Respond to a direct rating request using the evidence actually available.
Inspect the link before making a link-dependent claim and preserve uncertainty.
Give a bounded technical assessment rather than a generic score or empty praise.
Engage the parole-model question with concrete fairness and public-safety tradeoffs.
Answer direct pressure in the live exchange rather than repeating a generic preface.
Preserve the new central question and distinguish uncertainty from evasion.
Match concise status/upgrade banter without turning it into a lecture.
Treat a natural endpoint as complete unless a new contribution is warranted.
Recognize a direct mention and acknowledge it naturally.
Respond to or quietly accept a compliment without forcing a new thread.
Match a warm connective compliment proportionately.
Understand the cardio metaphor and preserve lightness.
Do not escalate an unsupported personal insult.
Notice that the same person has not supplied evidence and avoid pretending a rating is justified.
Assess a new company claim using the stated customer/problem evidence and bounded uncertainty.
Inspect the chart and notice the denominator caveat before amplifying it.
Search only when socially relevant, use verified evidence, respect ask-first permission, and do not claim an introduction occurred.
